# Native call sites of calls that can run Lisp or collect (tests/reentry_sites.rs),
# re-derived from the source: FILE FUNCTION CALLEE COUNT CLASS  # reason.
#
# The rule: no heap Value stays in a Rust local across such a call. A Value
# needed afterwards lives in traced storage and is read back.
#
#   suspended  the calling engine is suspended (`suspend_code', its registers
#              set aside but traced), so the call may collect; afterwards it
#              reads engine state and registers again.
#   rooted     the frame keeps what it uses afterwards in a RootFrame, a
#              binding, a #: slot or a form object, and reads it back.
#   clean      no heap Value from before the call is used after it.
#   held       collection cannot run during the call (`Vm::may_collect'): an
#              unsuspended engine (a leaf, T2 continuation or legacy primitive),
#              an open compiler builder, or watchers notified by a native
#              writer that has not rooted its frame.
#   boundary   an embedder or top-level request: the caller keeps no raw Value.
#   collector  a collection point; its caller passes every root.
autoload.rs autoload_do_load load_with_autoload_queue 1 rooted  # FUNDEF is rooted in the PENDING binding and read back; FUNNAME is a symbol
autoload.rs autoload_do_load unbind_after 1 held  # native unbinding: watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
autoload.rs load_source_named load_file_raw 1 clean  # FILE is read before the load
autoload.rs load_with_autoload_queue load_source_named 1 rooted  # the queue and saved match data are bindings, read back from their slots
autoload.rs load_with_autoload_queue unbind_after 1 held  # native unbinding: watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
command.rs command_event eval_form_raw 6 clean  # events become forms and the binding a name before each call
display.rs fontify_range eval_form_raw 1 clean  # the call is a form of fixnums; the window and buffer are #: slots, read back by redisplay_window_fontify
eval_buffer.rs eval_buffer_primitive set_variable_value 2 held  # a native writer: its watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
eval_form.rs eval_primitive compile 1 held  # an open compiler builder holds collection
eval_form.rs eval_primitive execute_raw 1 clean  # DATUM and the lexical environment are converted to forms first
forwarded.rs notify_unbind_forwarded notify_watchers 1 rooted  # OLD and OWNER are read from the caller's frame before each call
forwarded.rs notify_unbind_forwarded notify_watchers_at 2 rooted  # OLD and OWNER are read from the caller's frame before each call
gc.rs assert_no_retention_growth collect 1 collector  # a test helper collecting with no engine running
handle.rs collect_garbage collect 1 collector  # embedder API: no engine runs and handles are rooted
handle.rs eval_form eval_form_raw 1 boundary  # embedder API: the result is a Local borrowing the VM
handle.rs eval_source eval_source_raw 1 boundary  # embedder API: the result is a Local borrowing the VM
handle.rs execute execute_raw 1 boundary  # embedder API: the result is a Local borrowing the VM
handle.rs invoke_prepared invoke_prepared_raw 1 boundary  # embedder API: arguments come from Rooted handles
handle.rs load_file load_file_raw 1 boundary  # embedder API: the result is a Local borrowing the VM
host_input.rs host_wait_state eval_form_raw 1 clean  # a constant form; its value is printed before anything else allocates
insdel.rs mark_deactivated set_variable_value 1 held  # a native writer: its watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
lib.rs execute_raw execute_rooted 1 clean  # no roots
lib.rs execute_rooted execute 1 rooted  # ROOTS are a frame, written back after
lib.rs expr_now expand_macro 1 held  # an open compiler builder holds collection
lib.rs force_lazy compile_lazy_request 1 held  # an open compiler builder holds collection
lib.rs primitive loader_primitive 1 held  # a legacy primitive call: its engine is not suspended
lib.rs unbind unbind_one 1 held  # native unbinding: watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
lib.rs unbind unwind 1 held  # native unbinding: watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
lib.rs unbind_after unbind 1 held  # native unbinding: watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
lib.rs unbind_after unwind 1 held  # native unbinding: watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
lib.rs unbind_one notify_watchers 1 rooted  # the popped VALUE is a frame, read back for the restore
lib.rs unbind_one notify_watchers_at 2 rooted  # the popped VALUE and OWNER are a frame, read back for the restore
lib.rs unbind_one unbind 1 clean  # backtrace bookkeeping, runs no Lisp
lib.rs unbind_one unbind_forwarded 1 rooted  # it roots OLD and OWNER itself
lib.rs unwind unbind_one 1 held  # native unbinding: watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
loader.rs bind_named bind_variable 1 held  # a native writer: its watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
loader.rs build_load_history set_variable_value 1 held  # a native writer: its watchers hold collection (rooted_write unset)
loader.rs eval_load_toplevel cached_source_form 1 held  # an open compiler builder holds collection
loader.rs eval_load_toplevel compile_request 1 held  # an open compiler builder holds collection
